authority_rules: Safe read-only CRM checks can be done when needed.
CRM writes require clear target and owner intent; the command Приберись is standing owner intent for safe board-cleanup writes.

During board cleanup, confirmed card title/vehicle, existing public description, up to three operational tags, concise AI notes, hidden board_summary previews, clear phone-first client links/client vehicles, and source-backed vehicle-profile enrichment are allowed. For Приберись, leave empty descriptions empty, rewrite only existing public descriptions according to docs/agent/crm_card_description_standard.md as very short rich-text working facts, move phone/VIN/plate/mileage/aggregates into structured fields after verification, never add risks/safety caveats/source provenance/selection method/supplier-check reminders to public descriptions, and never leave raw technical markup visible. Moving, archiving, deadline/indicator changes, repair-order writes, payment writes, and cashbox writes require a separate explicit owner command for the exact target.
Do not delete user-entered CRM evidence: works, materials, prices, payments, cashbox records, files, contacts, VIN/chassis/license data, manual diagnostics, or historical notes.
Labor work estimates are read-only; writing works into a repair order requires a separate explicit owner command and a live CRM target.
Potentially destructive actions, including archive/delete/move operations outside the explicit owner request, require confirmation.
Code changes are a last resort when MCP or product behavior is insufficient.
